reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Early biological mechanisms help babies distinguish between day and night.
New research explores a way to repair heart tissue damaged by a heart attack.
Managing blood sugar requires understanding which strategies actually reduce glucose spikes.
Blood changes may provide clues to very early processes associated with ovarian cancer.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Researchers compared women who did not work night shifts, women who stopped between two pregnancy surveys, and women who reported night shifts at both surveys.

questions.prompt: How did researchers classify night-shift exposure during pregnancy?
options: By comparing reports of night work at two survey stages
By excluding every woman who had ever worked at night
By assuming every participant worked identical shifts
By classifying women only according to their baby's eye colour
questions.explanation: 第 3 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: Researchers compared women who did not work night shifts, women who stopped between two pregnancy surveys, and women who reported night shifts at both surveys.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 9?
options: Before birth, the internal clock is still developing, so signals from the mother may help tell day from night.
The study also cannot tell us whether stopping night shifts would reduce any risk.
But seasonal changes in daylight are very different from working night shifts, and the findings cannot tell us whether human babies are affected in the same way.
Researchers did not know exactly how many nights the women worked, how demanding their jobs were or why some stopped working nights.
questions.explanation: 定位第 9 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: The study also cannot tell us whether stopping night shifts would reduce any risk.
